note: The keep-listening reconnect with a backlog under lead_max_ns (the second Phase 1 review, D2): 60 s live, 2 s queued, drained in 1 s. The backlog's first PCR leaps (-2 s against arrival): one relock, one gap of the outage per PID (epoch), the new epoch seeded 2 s above the floor. Two agreeing buckets more than backlog_ns (500 ms, leap_ns: a backlog that relocks lies past it) below the line move it onto the floor at 65 s; the guard then drops what left on the seed once per PID (about 2 s, at 67 s), as at a start burst (B-37). The run before it (63.3-63.5 s, 1.8-2 s per PID) is the straddle rule taking the drain's tail onto the old epoch, whose line is the floor, under what the new one already sent; where each PID comes back to the new epoch, the hole that run left carries a gap marker (epoch, 1.8-2 s; B-48, before it had none). Before B-47: the line stayed 2 s above the floor (residual -1997 ms), the egress 2 s early for the 1.4 days the 20 ppm slew needs.
